name: Infra cloud: DigitalOcean and Cloudflare providers with markers, prune, adopt, destroy
description: Milestone 5. Providers for droplet, firewall, ssh_key, vpc, spaces_bucket, database_cluster (+ existing.*), cloudflare zone/record. Ownership markers per kind (tags, description, comment, .infra-owner object, name prefix), protect, exported, create-only vs replace fields, prune with --allow-destroy, adopt, destroy, show, plan --exit-code. Tests: recorded API responses plus opt-in live category. See docs infra-cli/ownership-markers and infra-cli/destroy-and-protect.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
